newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian Ukio, gas firm busy as shares gain.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian Ukio, gas firm busy as shares gain.

text.p: The Lithuanian stock market maintained its recent rise on Monday with Ukio Bank and mostly state-owned Lithuanian Gas actively traded.
The group A index, which traces the 35 most active stocks, rose 81.52 points to 1,785.44 while overall volume on the central market was 379,615 litas.
Bloc trades worth 391,662 litas were made while the secondary T-bill market turned over 4.95 million litas.
Lithuanian Gas continued to rise and went up to 1.48 litas from 1.41 litas on turnover of 82,732 litas.
The Birzai Milk firm continued to be among the most active after its recent launch of GDRs and rose to 8.2 litas from 8.15 litas on trade of 55,350 litas.
Ukio Bank was one of the most active bank stocks after it said that it was also planning a GDR issue to boost its share capital to 82 million litas from 42 million litas.
It turned over 125,466 litas but gained only slightly to 19.01 litas from 19.
Hermis Bank put in a rise to 200 litas from 195 litas on trade of 47,000 litas while Vilnius Bank saw low trade of 3,520 litas and rose to 181 litas from 165 litas.
